name: Greyson Clothiers
verdict: Detroit golf-apparel brand founded by Charlie Schaefer; its 2025 Series A was led by NewBound Ventures. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: founder-led private apparel company (greyson-ownership; company release, 2025-02-07) whose $20m Series A was led by NewBound Ventures with Tom Nolan, David Chu and NewBound's Michael Hoffman joining its board; its full share register isn't public. No state or state-fund shareholder named in any source, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company was found. Official apparel sponsor of Ripper GC and partner of Legion XIII (LIV Golf announcements).
